nominal.description: Single source of truth for this component's value. Units follow `kind`: length units for LINEAR, degrees for ANGULAR. Trig templates convert degrees to radians inside the expression string itself (e.g. cos(pi*A/180)).

lowerTol.description: - tolerance, stored as a positive magnitude

standardFit.description: Optional ISO 286 / ANSI B4.1 / ISO 2768 lookup source; when present, upperTol/lowerTol were auto-populated from this and remain user-overridable.

deltaT.description: °C, applied as L_eff = L0 * (1 + alpha * deltaT)
